notes: Two isnads of one saying (rule 4): the first («وروى عبيد الله الأشجعي») is one group; the second («حدثنا بذلك أبو كريب») follows right after it and is a second group
«قوله» and «نحوه» are the Companion's words and wording; «ولم يرفعه» is a remark that the report is not raised to the Prophet: left out
The second isnad repeats every name, so there is no shared tail; each repeated name carries its occurrence number
